**Finding submitted: deviation (WARRANTY).**

**What I found.** Section 9 ("Warranties," paras p0055–p0058) contains only mutual corporate representations — organization, authority, enforceability, no conflicts — plus an HDI acknowledgement regarding the Globix Agreement. I checked the rest of the document: HDI's obligations sections (1.1–1.8, 5.1–5.4) impose performance duties but contain no warranty; there is no conformance warranty, no compliance-with-laws or malicious-code warranty, and no warranty remedy anywhere.

**Classification reasoning.** This fails even the fallback (90 days software / 30 days services with repair, replace or refund), because there is no express performance warranty at all. Two mitigating points I noted in the rationale rather than treating as cures: Section 5.2 gives the Company written acceptance control over the Site, and Section 1.6 lets the Company terminate without penalty if the Site is not operational within 70 days. Notably, there is also **no** "AS IS" disclaimer or implied-warranty waiver, so this is a gap rather than walk-away territory — and it means no disclaimer carve-out is needed in the redline.

**Redline (validated ok:true).** A new Section 9(c) inserted after p0058, at the preferred position: workmanlike performance of the Services, 90-day conformance for the Site and deliverables keyed to the existing Section 5.2 acceptance mechanic, compliance with laws, no malicious code, and a re-performance/repair/replacement remedy with refund if HDI fails to cure within 30 days. The comment flags that a shorter period or narrower remedy is negotiable.
